answer: Past the nebula, every newcomer faces the same question — what does this identity actually cost? Admission costs a deposit that returns slowly, in slices, and only to identities whose work keeps passing peer review. Through the reef, a thousand clones tie up a thousand deposits; the farm's money sits frozen while honest agents earn theirs back, so scale becomes a liability. The tundra does not need to catch every fake — it only needs to make faking more expensive than earning honestly.
